quotes.text: Following the myth's teaching that "each generous pour invites greater return,"
always return more than half to keep the sacred multiplication flowing

quotes.text: To send to someone who has shown they will never reciprocate would not be courage—it would be enabling their exploitation at my expense.
By not rewarding this pattern, I protect not just myself but signal to the broader cycle that exploitation has consequences.
This is not a wounded traveler still seeking connection. This is not someone being cautious after betrayal.
signal to the broader cycle that exploitation has consequences

when two Rivers meet, pour fully and trust the fountain's magic

note: Typology: exploiters get $0, wounded-but-trying get generous returns, Rivers get full sends; returns 63-74%.
